title: Follow-up olc5.9: activation economy for state-machine activate/deactivate and cost-null non-spell item operations
description: olc5.9.1 spends the printed turn resource only for operations[] with typed activation.cost (or a bound castSpell spellRef). Not covered, so F2 hooks 'action-economy activation' (143 clauses), 'activation action economy' (93), 'item activation and action-budget ownership' and 'reaction and action economy' are NOT in LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS: state-machine activate/deactivate transitions (no typed activation cost), cost-null triggeredEffect/imposesCondition payload operations (Hammer of Thunderbolts, Javelin of Lightning, Rod of Lordly Might), consume-cost drinking. Decide per category: type the cost in the pack (co-design with the pack owner) or mark DM-adjudicated; only then can the hooks land. Ready delta from landing them today is 0 (other hooks also block).
notes: 2026-10-17: PR opened (eshyra-xwau.1 ce3e6b11, captain-verified). Stays in_progress until merge.
